_comment: Martyr Lifegain (2026-11-11), the Martyr loop with ONE Martyr: cast Martyr of Sands and sacrifice it in the SAME main. Resumed in main 1 of T4 (drop used), 2 Plains, Serra Ascendant (not sick); hand Martyr + three Ranger of Eos (white, uncastable). Life 21, opponent 6. Cast Martyr ({W}) -- a site-9 breakpoint -- then its continuation sacrifices it ({1}) revealing the three Rangers: +9 -> 30, Serra 6/6 lifelink swings for 6. BINDING: win T4, life 36 = 30 + 6. Filler Emrakul (colourless, uncastable): a drawn card can neither be played nor revealed.
